messages.subject: Project Aquilo - executed Master Supply Agreement
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

I'm pleased to confirm that the Master Manufacture and Supply Agreement between Harrow Precision Engineering Limited and Calderwater Utilities Limited has now been signed by both parties. The fully executed PDF is attached for your records, incorporating the agreed terms (including the £4,000,000 aggregate liability cap with a £5,000,000 IP indemnity sub-cap, the 8% shortfall payment, the 4% CPI indexation cap, 45-day payment terms and the 24-month warranty). Originals will follow by post.

It's been a pleasure working with everyone on this. Congratulations to both teams.

Kind regards,

Elena Marchetti
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
T +44 (0)20 7946 0048
whitfieldcarter.com
